anomalies.description: A severely crushed passenger car is stationary on the highway shoulder, with a white semi-truck passing slowly to its left and a green truck visible behind it; the scene remains static across all frames, indicating the accident has already occurred and vehicles are maneuvering around the wreckage.

A silver sedan in the left lane collides with a dark vehicle ahead, causing the sedan to spin sharply left, lose control, and come to rest diagonally across the lane with visible front and rear damage and smoke/dust emission.

A silver sedan is severely damaged and stationary on the left side of a two-lane road, with its front end crumpled and hood raised; smoke or vapor is visible near the front, indicating a recent collision. The vehicle remains in the same position across all frames, suggesting the accident occurred just before or at the start of this clip.

A silver sedan is severely damaged on the left shoulder of a two-lane road, with its front end crumpled and hood detached; smoke/vapor is visible near the engine bay in later frames, indicating recent collision.; At an intersection, a black SUV collides with a white station wagon while both are turning or crossing; the SUV’s front right side impacts the station wagon’s driver-side door/rear quarter panel.

A vehicle on the right side of the road (likely a truck or van) collides with another vehicle or object, producing a visible burst of smoke/debris at approximately 91.0 seconds. The impact is evident in frames f5–f8, with smoke persisting through f9.

A multi-vehicle collision occurs on the right side of the road: a dark vehicle (possibly a truck or bus) veers sharply right, impacts a blue structure and other vehicles, resulting in visible debris, smoke, and vehicle deformation. The crash unfolds across frames f8 to f15.; A vehicle (likely a truck or bus) is seen overturned on its side in the middle of the road, with debris scattered across lanes, indicating a recent crash.

A person walks toward the crash site and appears to interact aggressively with a figure lying or crouched near the wreckage; the posture and proximity suggest possible assault on a vulnerable individual.
A black sedan is seen colliding with a building or structure at the roadside, producing smoke/dust; impact and post-impact position confirm a crash.

A black sedan collides with a structure (likely a toll booth or kiosk) on the right side of the road, producing visible smoke/dust upon impact.; A red bus and multiple cars are involved in a multi-vehicle incident at a roundabout; vehicles appear to be stopped or in collision configuration, with some misaligned positions suggesting recent impact.
